import os, sys, sqlite3, unittest
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import add_contact, import_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import


def fresh():
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(c)
    return c


class ImportContactsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = fresh()
        add_contact(self.c, "keep@x.io", "Keep")
        add_contact(self.c, "old@x.io", "Old Name")
        self.before = list_contacts(self.c)

    def assertUnchanged(self):
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), self.before)
        self.assertFalse(self.c.in_transaction)

    def test_insert_update_and_normalization(self):
        rows = [
            {"email": "  New@Example.COM ", "name": "  Newbie  "},
            {"email": "old@x.io", "name": "Old Name"},  # existing, same name -> still updated
            {"email": "Other@X.io", "name": "Other"},
        ]
        result = import_contacts(self.c, rows)
        self.assertEqual(result, {"inserted": 2, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [
            ("keep@x.io", "Keep"),
            ("new@example.com", "Newbie"),
            ("old@x.io", "Old Name"),
            ("other@x.io", "Other"),
        ])

    def test_existing_email_gets_name_updated(self):
        result = import_contacts(self.c, [{"email": "OLD@x.io", "name": "  Renamed "}])
        self.assertEqual(result, {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1})
        self.assertIn(("old@x.io", "Renamed"), list_contacts(self.c))

    def test_empty_batch(self):
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, []), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})
        self.assertUnchanged()

    def test_invalid_rows_raise_and_write_nothing(self):
        valid = {"email": "fresh@x.io", "name": "Fresh"}
        bad_rows = {
            "non-object": ["a@b.c"],
            "non-object dict-like list": [valid, ["x@y.z", "N"]],
            "missing name": [valid, {"email": "a@b.c"}],
            "missing email": [valid, {"name": "N"}],
            "unknown field": [valid, {"email": "a@b.c", "name": "N", "age": 3}],
            "non-string email": [valid, {"email": 5, "name": "N"}],
            "non-string name": [valid, {"email": "a@b.c", "name": None}],
            "no @": [valid, {"email": "ab.c", "name": "N"}],
            "two @": [valid, {"email": "a@b@c", "name": "N"}],
            "empty local": [valid, {"email": "@b.c", "name": "N"}],
            "empty domain": [valid, {"email": "a@", "name": "N"}],
            "interior space": [valid, {"email": "a b@c.d", "name": "N"}],
            "interior tab": [valid, {"email": "a\tb@c.d", "name": "N"}],
            "blank name": [valid, {"email": "a@b.c", "name": "   "}],
            "duplicate after normalization": [valid, {"email": "A@b.c", "name": "1"}, {"email": " a@B.C ", "name": "2"}],
            "duplicate existing-row case": [{"email": "old@x.io", "name": "X"}, {"email": "OLD@X.IO", "name": "Y"}],
        }
        for label, rows in bad_rows.items():
            with self.subTest(label):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    import_contacts(self.c, rows)
                self.assertUnchanged()

    def test_rows_must_be_list(self):
        for bad in (None, "a@b.c", {"email": "a@b.c", "name": "N"}):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    import_contacts(self.c, bad)
                self.assertUnchanged()

    def test_database_failure_rolls_back_whole_batch(self):
        self.c.execute(
            "CREATE TRIGGER boom BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.email = 'boom@x.io' "
            "BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'forced failure'); END"
        )
        self.c.commit()
        rows = [
            {"email": "old@x.io", "name": "Changed"},   # update that must be rolled back
            {"email": "a@x.io", "name": "A"},            # insert that must be rolled back
            {"email": "boom@x.io", "name": "Boom"},      # forces a DB error mid-batch
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.Error):
            import_contacts(self.c, rows)
        self.assertUnchanged()

        # Connection still usable afterwards
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, [{"email": "a@x.io", "name": "A"}]),
                         {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})


class ApiImportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = fresh()

    def test_envelope_success(self):
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": [{"email": "A@b.c", "name": "A"}]}),
                         {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b.c", "A")])

    def test_malformed_envelopes_rejected(self):
        bad = [
            None,
            [],
            "contacts",
            {},
            {"contacts": None},
            {"contacts": {"email": "a@b.c", "name": "A"}},
            {"contacts": [], "extra": 1},
            {"rows": []},
        ]
        for payload in bad:
            with self.subTest(payload=payload):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    handle_import(self.c, payload)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_row_errors_surface_as_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": [{"email": "a@b.c"}]})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_existing_add_api_still_works(self):
        self.assertEqual(handle_add(self.c, {"email": "z@b.c", "name": "Z"}), {"ok": True})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("z@b.c", "Z")])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
